page.hero_title: The whole Bible, word by word.
page.hero_lede: The 66 books in the original, each word with transliteration, pronunciation, Strong's number and an English gloss, and under each verse the text of the Berean Standard Bible. Free, open and without ads — in the browser, on the phone, in EPUB and in PDF.
page.hero_note: No account needed. Works offline once opened. Prefer an app, EPUB or PDF? See how to download.
page.f_cards_text: Original word, transliteration, pronunciation, Strong's number and gloss. Each layer turns on and off.
page.f_entries_text: Tap a word: origin, meaning, grammatical analysis and how the Berean Standard Bible translates that word elsewhere.
page.f_goto_text: Type Jn 3:16, ps 23 or just 1:14. In the index, one tap on a chapter opens it.
page.f_about_text: Summary, people, timeline, places and context for each of the 66 books, and a theme for each chapter.
page.f_listen_text: The verse is read in Hebrew or Greek by the device's voice, highlighting each word; it can speak more slowly.
page.f_modes_text: Read only the Berean Standard Bible, like an ordinary Bible, only the original, both side by side, the interlinear or the study mode — or build your own.
page.f_mark_text: Colors on verses, passages or words of the original, notes, bookmarks and tags — all kept on your device, without an account.
page.f_notebook_text: Export your notes and highlights as a study notebook in PDF, with the text and the interlinear. Download everything in one file and import it on another device.
page.f_sync_text: Optional: sign in with Google and your notes and reading mode follow you on the phone and the computer. They stay in a private app folder in your Drive — the project has no server and does not see your data.
page.f_progress_text: With the account connected: how much of the Bible you have read, reading time per day, streaks, the map of the 66 books and plans like the Bible in a year — added up across all devices.
page.f_questions_text: At the end of the chapter, questions to think about or discuss in a group — observe, interpret, look at the original and apply — with no ready-made answers. Your answer becomes a note.
page.f_access_text: Six color themes, text size, an easy-reading font, screen reader and keyboard. Once opened, it works offline.
page.howto_title: See each feature in under 30 seconds
page.howto_lede: Short videos, without sound, with captions and the written steps. Recorded from the app itself and remade automatically when something changes.
page.howto_noscript: Turn on JavaScript to see the videos. The steps of each feature are in the repository's documentation.
page.books_title: The 66 books, each with its own page
page.books_lede: The introduction of each book and the chapters in the original, word by word, with the Berean Standard Bible alongside.
page.download_title: In the browser, on the phone, in EPUB or in PDF
page.site_text: Opens in any browser and can be installed on the home screen of the phone or the computer (browser menu › Install or Add to home screen). Once opened, it works offline.
page.android_text: An app with the whole Bible inside, no internet needed to read. Download the APK on the phone and install it (allow installing from unknown sources). On the Play Store: coming soon.
page.ios_text: The iOS app project is ready in the repository and goes to the App Store when the Apple developer account is active. Meanwhile, install the website on the home screen from Safari (Share › Add to Home Screen).
page.files_title: Books to download: EPUB and PDF
page.files_text: They are on the repository's Releases page and GitHub builds them again with each correction to the data, so the links always bring the latest version. In the EPUB, each word of the original is a note that opens on tap (it works on the Kindle). The PDF is A4, with the word cards, the Berean Standard Bible under each verse and bookmarks by book and chapter.
page.kindle: On the Kindle: send the EPUB with Send to Kindle (up to 200 MB from the app or website; by email, up to 50 MB — use the OT, the NT or one book).
page.repo_text: __REPO_CURTO__ — data (glosses, lexicon, themes, corrections), scripts that build everything from the open sources, the Android and iOS app, the workflows that publish the website and the books, and the documentation.
page.made_title: Only open sources, from start to finish
page.made_lede: Everything can be copied and redistributed. The glosses are the project's and are not part of the Berean Standard Bible.
page.made_limits: Limitations: the glosses come from automatic alignment and are sometimes misplaced; themes and introductions still await human review. The ⚑ sign on a verse shows what the automatic review found.
page.step1_text: Hebrew and Aramaic from the Westminster Leningrad Codex (Open Scriptures) and Greek from the SBL Greek New Testament with the morphology of MorphGNT.
page.step2_text: The running text in English, verse by verse, with the numbering of English Bibles.
page.step3_text: Each word of the original is linked to the part of the Berean Standard Bible that translates it (eflomal), completed by rules and by review.
page.step4_text: Strong's dictionary, the introduction of each book and the theme of each chapter.
page.step5_text: Checks on the data and tests of the website with each change, before publishing the website, the app, the EPUBs and the PDFs.
page.fix_text: Anyone can suggest corrections to glosses, lexicon entries and introductions. The guide explains the way, from the file to the pull request.

sources.translation: Running translation: Berean Standard Bible (BSB), berean.bible, dedicated to the public domain in 2023, via the eBible corpus. Text reproduced without changes.
sources.lexicon: Lexicon: James Strong's dictionary (public domain), Open Scriptures digital edition (CC BY-SA); Jeffrey Dodson's Greek lexicon (public domain).
sources.glosses: Word-by-word glosses: obtained by statistical alignment between the original and the translation (the eflomal tool) and completed by rules. Glosses in gray italics did not come from a direct alignment. They are not part of the translation and are not endorsed by its authors. ⚑ marks points flagged by the automatic review.
sources.other: Book introductions and chapter themes: written for this project. Audio: generated on the fly by the voice installed on the device; no audio file is distributed. edition.text_intro: Text of the Berean Standard Bible (BSB), with the theme of each chapter written by the Bíblia Interlinear project. To see the original word by word, use the interlinear edition.
